answer: You don't have to wait to act: you can request a new offer at any time once your old one expires. The new offer won't necessarily match the old price, because it reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower. Since North Carolina duplicate titles take 4 to 6 weeks to arrive, offers can run out while you wait, and we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. New offers are valid for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first, so you may want to request the new offer once your title is in hand.
